eyebrow.zh: 并行 Agent · 跨 worktree · 本地运行

headline.zh:
谁把谁的密钥
带进了谁的提交
headline.en:
Whose secret bled
into whose commit

sub.zh: 并行跑多个 coding agent 时，一个 agent 的 .env 会静默渗进另一个的 commit——LeakMap 实时抓到并归因到来源 agent。
sub.en: When you run parallel coding agents, one agent's .env silently bleeds into another's commit. LeakMap catches it live and attributes the source.

body.zh: 实时监听每个 worktree 的写入；Agent B 一写下 Agent A 的密钥值，立刻发出归因事件——不用等事后扫描。
body.en: Watches every worktree's writes in real time; the instant Agent B writes Agent A's secret value, an attributed event fires — no after-the-fact scan.

body.zh: 不止告诉你「发现了密钥」，而是「Agent A 的 DB_TOKEN 出现在了 Agent B 的提交里」——来源 worktree、目标 worktree、agent 进程，全部留痕。
body.en: Not just 'a secret was found' — 'Agent A's DB_TOKEN appeared in Agent B's commit.' Source worktree, target worktree, agent process — all on the record.

body.zh: 所有 worktree 当节点、渗漏当边，渲染成 leak-map——终端、本地网页、Markdown 报告任选，外加一条 JSONL 审计流。
body.en: Every worktree a node, every bleed an edge — rendered as a leak-map in terminal, local web page, or Markdown, plus a JSONL audit stream.

title.zh: 本地运行，密钥不出机器

body.zh: 一条命令装好，全在本机跑；不上云、不要 API key、不外发任何数据。
body.en: One command to install, runs entirely on your machine — no cloud, no API key, nothing sent out.

headline.zh: 并行 agent 越跑越多，先看清谁在渗漏谁
headline.en: More parallel agents, more bleeds — see who leaks into whom first

sub.zh: git worktree add 完，跑一条 leakmap watch
sub.en: After git worktree add, run leakmap watch

tag.zh: MIT · 本地运行 · 一条命令装好
